summary: All 7 spec-surrogate ACs and all 3 mini-plan work items are present, faithful and in-scope. AC-1: sweep_outbox.py's local _op_in_progress (36 LOC) and _has_staged_changes are deleted and replaced by the exact re-export import the plan specifies; run_git_soft/TIMEOUT_RETURNCODE/HOOK_GIT_TIMEOUT stay imported and are still used by the untouched staged-delta and commit call sites. AC-2: _ci_active is byte-untouched. AC-3: the worktree/main-tree split holds. AC-4: the is_detached asymmetry is kept and explicitly reasoned in main_tree_guards.py's docstring; is_detached is NOT imported into sweep_outbox. AC-5/Ledger row 6: the OSError widening is the only behavior delta and is pinned by exactly the three new tests both external reviewers asked for. AC-7: nothing outside the card touched. Plan item 2 delivered prose-only with NO signature change. Plan item 3: all three timeout tests retargeted to mtg.run_git_soft, the re-export identity assert added, and the two 4-tuple _PRIVATE_ALIASES rows added and structurally valid. Two non-blocking observations noted and not rejected on: (1) the caller-tree clarification landed at module-docstring level rather than a per-function parameter line -- correct placement since main_root is shared across four functions; (2) the plan's own parenthetical claiming triage_gc_publish uses op_in_progress only was factually wrong (it uses all three guards) -- the actual docstring written never carried that error, and the plan file has been corrected post-review. Code-reviewer may proceed.
